description: This Java class 'StimulationInputs' provides a user interface panel for configuring engine stimulation parameters such as RPM range, engine load, coolant temperature (CLT), intake air temperature (IAT), throttle position (TPS), and EL resistance. It builds a Swing UI component with various controls including sliders and spinners to set these parameters, used for tuning or testing an engine control system.

classes.name: StimulationInputs
classes.description: A Swing UI component class that allows configuration of engine stimulation parameters such as RPM range, engine load, temperature sensors, throttle position, and EL resistance, for use in testing or tuning engine control software.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum engine load value from the UI control.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum engine load value from the UI control.

methods.name: getRpmFrom
methods.description: Returns the starting RPM value set in the UI.

methods.name: getRpmTo
methods.description: Returns the ending RPM value set in the UI.

methods.name: getRpmStep
methods.description: Returns the RPM step value for increments.

methods.name: getCltFrom
methods.description: Returns the minimum coolant temperature (CLT) value.

methods.name: getCltTo
methods.description: Returns the maximum coolant temperature (CLT) value.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all the UI components.

methods.name: getEngineLoadR2Resistance
methods.description: Returns the resistance value input for engine load simulation.

methods.name: getEngineLoadStep
methods.description: Returns the step value for engine load adjustments.
